title: Fast Point Cloud Generation with Straight Flows
tldr_zh: 把 rectified flow 的 reflow+蒸馏引入点云扩散，一步生成，采样 0.04s，比 PVD 快 700×
tldr_en: Applies rectified flow reflow+distillation to point cloud diffusion, achieving one-step generation at 0.04s, ~700x faster than PVD
